title: Understanding Logistic Regression Coefficients
text: In logistic regression, the sign of a coefficient indicates the direction of the relationship between the feature and the probability of the outcome. If a coefficient is negative, what does that imply about the relationship between the feature and the probability of the wine being type 1?

title: Standardized Features
text: Remember that the features in the design matrix X are standardized. How does standardization affect the interpretation of the coefficients in logistic regression?

hintAnswer: It suggests that as abv increases, the probability of the wine being type $$1$$ decreases.
title: Interpreting the Coefficient Sign
text: If the weight for the abv feature is negative, what does this suggest about the relationship between abv and the probability of the wine being type 1?
choices: It suggests that as abv increases, the probability of the wine being type $$1$$ decreases.

hintAnswer: Standardization affects the scale of the coefficients, making them comparable.
